title: wg followup: PR for mimi-protocol#159 (franking checks else-branch)
description: mimi-protocol#159 ready-for-PR. Rohan: 'if franking is required, discard the message. If only some of the franking fields are present, discard the message'; room id is bytes and sender URI is a URI, 'both have built-in comparison rules'; identity types are draft-mahy-mimi-identity's business (no WG consensus). PR text: add the else branch (franking required + fields absent or partial -> discard), and cite the comparison rules (byte equality for room id; RFC 3986 §6 for the URI). Leave the credential-domain question out (decided elsewhere). Beads mimid-1wgh.37.46/.37.61. Post needs Mark's OK.
